long_biography.plain_text:
At Seven Energy, Kola Aluko helped turn a Weatherford-linked partnership into a Nigerian exploration and production company. He led the 2007 management buyout after Exoro Energy had worked with Energy Ventures International, then served as deputy chief executive and board director until 2011. The company later developed gas processing and pipeline assets.

Aluko also co-founded the Made in Africa Foundation with Ozwald Boateng. Working with the African Development Bank, the foundation helped launch fundraising for Africa50, a vehicle intended to accelerate early-stage infrastructure development. The partnership concentrated on feasibility studies and project preparation for commercially viable power, transport and urban schemes across the continent.
